Bhavna Sharma | bhavna.sharma369@example.com | +91 9563263551
Location: Chennai

Professional Summary
Backend engineer focused on building scalable web services and data-processing pipelines. Strong track record delivering feature-driven APIs, optimizing database performance, and implementing reliable background processing. Comfortable working across the stack from services to deployment and monitoring. Immediate joiner.

Technical Skills
Python3, Django, PostgreSQL, AWS, Redis, Docker, Celery, Flask, Linux, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Backend Engineer, Zoho (Jan 2025 - Present)
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for a multi-tenant SaaS module using Django and Python3, improving average request throughput by 30% through query optimization and connection pooling with PostgreSQL.
- Built background job workflows with Celery workers orchestrated on Docker containers, reducing end-to-end batch processing time by 40% and improving retry/error handling.
- Tuned PostgreSQL indices and query plans, introduced async worker patterns and Redis caching to cut API latency p95 by 25%.

Python Developer, Covalent Infotech (Nov 2019 - Dec 2024)
- Developed core backend services in Django and Python3 for an analytics product, integrating AWS S3 for storage and RDS PostgreSQL for transactional data.
- Implemented Celery-based task queues with Redis as broker to handle high-throughput background processing, increasing job throughput and lowering failure rates through improved retry policies.
- Containerized services with Docker and deployed on AWS ECS, automated deployments and monitoring via Linux-based scripts and Jira-driven CI/CD pipelines.

Python Developer, Trellis Systems (Nov 2018 - Oct 2019)
- Built microservices in Flask and Python3 for real-time notification and session management, leveraging Redis for fast in-memory session storage and pub/sub.
- Implemented health checks, logging, and container deployment workflows using Docker and Linux tooling to improve service reliability and mean time to recovery.
- Collaborated on performance tuning of Redis-backed caches to reduce database load and improve endpoint response times.

Python Developer, Vertex Analytics (Dec 2017 - Oct 2018)
- Implemented asynchronous data ingestion and ETL jobs using Celery workers to process high-volume event streams, improving pipeline throughput and smoothing downstream loads.
- Packaged services into Docker containers and maintained Linux-based deployment scripts to standardize environments across staging and production.
- Contributed to task monitoring and alerting, working with engineering team via Jira to prioritize and resolve production issues.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
